content.text: {"core": "Abstraction pulls lived experience up into pattern — the specific becomes general, the general becomes principle. Seated in its own position, it works on thinking itself: the patterns that organize how patterns get made. Underdone, no distance forms between the thing and the thought about it. The particular floods the capacity to see kinds, and what could teach by resemblance just accumulates.", "sheetLine": "Nothing lifts into pattern; each thing stays only itself."}
